title: Chapter 28 Bronze Boss
content:
Chapter 28 Bronze Boss

"It seems that this defensive battle is coming to an end!" A lord with fiery red hair laughed.

"Don't jump to conclusions until the last moment of death."

Just when Wang Shuo's blood volume had dropped to around 100.

The system prompts:

[The production of the golden armored warrior is completed. 】

Wang Shuo quickly summoned it from his backpack.

[Golden Armor Warrior: Bronze level puppet, attack power 220, defense power 50, durability: 5000. 】

(1 energy crystal provides power for one day, and combat consumes 1 energy crystal per minute.)

The golden-armored warrior is 2.5 meters tall. His whole body is covered in golden armor. He holds a large sword about 2 meters long in his hand, which is extremely sharp.

Wang Shuo immediately invested 30 points of energy crystals and gave it an order to clean up the monsters.

With a "pop" sound, the golden-armored warrior jumped 5 meters away and jumped into the group of mud monsters.

With one stroke of the knife, more than ten monsters were killed instantly.

Wang Shuo was stunned by its combat power.

The mud monster's defense against swords is not absolute!

In the face of absolute power, the sludge monster is as fragile as a piece of paper.

He quickly fled to a relatively safe section of the wall. At this time, it was important to save his life.

After getting a moment of respite, he quickly took the time to search for a life-restoring potion in the trading shop.

At this time, there is actually a player selling "life potion".

10 gold coins.

Wang Shuo quickly contacted the player and made a request to trade energy crystals.

Now he has no gold coins, and the battlefield is full of energy crystals.

Fortunately, the other party agreed, and Wang Shuo used 10 energy crystals in exchange for 2 bottles of life potions.

Each bottle of life potion can only replenish 50 points of health, and Wang Shuo's health has been restored to close to 200 points.

The golden-armored warrior was also fighting with the leader of the sludge monster at this time.

When the long knife comes out, it can cut away large swaths of sludge every time, and the sludge monster leader's health continues to decrease.

Suddenly, a large mud puddle appeared at the feet of the golden armored warrior.

Wang Shuo knew that if he didn't take action, the golden-armored warrior might be defeated.

So he quickly joined the battle, and when he came to the edge of the mud pit, Wang Shuo threw out a rope. With the help of the rope, the golden armored warrior escaped from the mud pit trap.

In the following battle, the golden-armored warrior kept wandering around, avoiding the skills of the leader of the sludge monster, and constantly outputting damage to it. Its health quickly dropped below 2,000.

At this moment, a huge crocodile, although it has not reached the level of an elite monster, is not too different. It and a toad with colorful bumps all over its body, like a calf-sized toad, appeared in the In front of Wang Shuo's eyes.

His heart was pounding, and Wang Shuo's eyes were filled with fear.

He shot an arrow and checked the information.

[ID frog 00010 Wentai, bronze boss, level 10, health value 5000. 】

Before it had time to check more information, its tongue swept over. Fortunately, Wang Shuo reacted quickly and directly threw the bow and arrow in his hand. Then he blocked it, dodged to the side, and escaped.

And in place, a huge pit was left.

Seeing that he was defeated, Wang Shuo decisively took out the "Mercenary Contract".

He now desperately needs new help.

[Should you summon mercenaries? 】

"yes."

[To hire F-level mercenaries (rookies, just registered as mercenaries, and have not experienced any battles yet), you need to pay 1 gold coin per day (you can use energy crystals instead, 1 energy crystal is equal to 10 gold coins), E-level mercenaries, you can It costs 10 gold coins per hour to deal with ordinary beasts. D-level mercenaries can deal with bronze bosses at 100 gold coins per hour...]

"I'll go, it's really worth every penny."

"Hire D-class mercenaries." Wang Shuo made his choice.

Seeing the energy crystal exchange price given by the system, Wang Shuo felt that he had made a loss on the life potion just now.

【Energy Crystal-10】

A formation suddenly appeared in front of Wang Shuo's eyes, a burst of white light flashed, and a man wearing armor stood in front of Wang Shuo.

"Thank you boss for hiring me. I am D-class mercenary Wang Yanbing, reporting to you."

Wang Shuo took a look.

[Wang Yanbing: D-class mercenary, level 10, combat power 200. 】

Wang Yanbing just glanced at it and looked solemn for a moment.

"I'll go, is the battle so fierce?" Wang Yanbing was startled. Seeing that the surroundings were covered with corpses, and there was a bronze boss nearby, he couldn't help but frown, and with a flicker, he avoided the toad's tongue.

"Boss, what are your needs?" Although he had some guesses, Wang Yanbing still asked politely out of professional habits.

"Of course, all the monsters were eliminated." Wang Shuo gasped and took out a simple knife from his backpack again.

"Making customers satisfied is our aim, okay, boss!"

After Wang Yanbing finished speaking, he also took out a big knife, jumped in front of the toad, and slashed out with the knife, but the fire was scattered everywhere, and the defense was not even broken.

"There's some information!"

Licking his lips, he jumped 3 meters high and landed on the toad's back, so that he could avoid its attacks and look for opportunities to find the toad's weaknesses.

The situation was initially under control. The golden-armored warrior and the leader of the sludge monster fought together. Wang Yanbing dragged the bronze boss toad, while the remaining crocodile approached Wang Shuo again.

This crocodile was very fierce, and Wang Shuo seemed to see hatred in its eyes.

Are these beasts so intelligent now?

Wang Shuo was a little bit unbelievable, but now the war was critical, and if he was distracted, he might die.

Wang Shuo naturally did not have the ability to fight it head-on, so he had to keep wandering around. He glanced at Wang Yanbing, and the hope of breaking the situation fell on the golden armored warrior.

Wang Shuo quickly commanded the golden armored warrior to kill the leader of the sludge monster, and he wandered to the side of the sludge monster leader, and took the time to use "mud" to interfere with it.

Looking at the health of the sludge monster, Wang Shuo felt that he could not take it down for a while.

Checking the backpack, he found that there were still 150 arrows.

He kept adjusting his position, walked to the arrow tower, put all the arrows into the arrow tower, and shot at the giant crocodile.

The crocodile's health was only 1500, and after a round of burst shooting, only a layer of blood skin was left.

However, Wang Shuo still found it difficult to break its defense.

He wanted to end its life himself, but he was not strong enough.

He had to order the golden-armored warrior to turn around and cut it with a knife.

Before the crocodile died, a huge golden figure jumped down from the sky, and the blade touched its back, leaving a huge cut.

[Your puppet golden-armored warrior killed a level 6 crocodile. ]

Wang Shuo did not have time to check the kill information, or even to see what good stuff he had exploded.

The attack of the mud monster leader fell on him again, and Wang Shuo lost 25 points of health again.

"Ah!"

This really hurts, and he quickly hid behind the golden-armored warrior. If there are two more hits, Wang Shuo will die.

The surrounding monsters were constantly affected, and the number dropped to less than 100.

Wang Shuo and the golden-armored warrior focused on dealing with the mud monster leader.

"Boss, this boss is quite ferocious!"

"Not so fierce, I can call for help, what, can't you handle it?"

"It's not that I can't handle it, but I need to pay a certain price to kill it, so you have to pay more!"
